description: Get detailed status for one app: deploy status, URL, last deployed commit, and any error message. Call this to check whether a deploy has finished, to get an app's live URL, or to see why an app is in error. Status DEPLOYING with ready_at set means the new version is already reachable at its URL and Dockhold is confirming it stays up; the user can open it now. It moves to RUNNING once confirmed, or to ERROR with an error_message if it crashed.

app_id.description: The app id returned by list_apps

name: get_app_status
title: Get app status
